name: OmaCalc-84
author: omarchy.fans
description: A full TI-84 Plus-style graphing calculator one click from your Omarchy bar. Graph functions, parametrics, polars and sequences with zoom, trace and the CALC menu; build tables; run 1-Var/2-Var stats, eleven regressions and fifteen statistics tests; and work with lists, matrices, complex numbers and every DISTR distribution, on a faithful calculator faceplate that follows your Omarchy theme.

barWidget.description: Bar button that opens the graphing calculator.
